evals.prompt: I just merged a bunch of fixes into main and I want to get a new build out to my testers on TestFlight. Can you walk me through the whole thing? I'd rather use the CLI if possible but tell me when I need to go to a website.
evals.expected_output: Step-by-step guide starting with eas build, monitoring the build, then eas submit, then what to do in App Store Connect / TestFlight. Should mention --auto-submit as a shortcut. Should clearly delineate CLI steps vs web-required steps.
expectations: Runs or recommends `eas build --platform ios --profile production`
Explains how to monitor the build (eas build:list or the build URL)
Runs or recommends `eas submit --platform ios --profile production --latest`
Mentions the --auto-submit flag as a shortcut to combine build+submit
Explains that Apple processing takes 5-30 minutes after submission
Tells the user to verify the build in TestFlight / App Store Connect
Clearly separates what can be done via CLI vs what requires a browser

evals.prompt: I kicked off an EAS build like 20 minutes ago and I don't remember the URL. How do I check if it's done? Also once it finishes I want to know my options for getting it to testers without using the terminal.
evals.expected_output: Shows how to find the build status via CLI and web dashboard. Then walks through non-CLI options for TestFlight distribution (Expo dashboard submit button, Transporter app, App Store Connect).
expectations: Runs or recommends `eas build:list` to find the build and its status
Mentions the Expo web dashboard as an alternative to check build status
Provides the Expo dashboard URL pattern or tells user to go to expo.dev
Explains at least 2 non-CLI options for submitting to TestFlight (e.g. Expo dashboard button, Transporter app, or manual upload via ASC)
Does NOT default to CLI commands for the submission part since user asked for non-terminal options

evals.prompt: OK so we've been testing 1.0.0 on TestFlight for a week and everything looks good. I want to do a full App Store release — bump the version to 1.1.0 and release it to production. Give me the full rundown of everything I need to do.
evals.expected_output: Complete release workflow: version bump considerations, production build, submission, App Store Connect metadata, review submission. Should mention that version is in app.json and that build numbers auto-increment via EAS.
expectations: Addresses the version bump from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0 (updating app.json version field)
Explains that build numbers auto-increment via EAS (appVersionSource: remote)
Includes submitting to App Store Connect
Walks through the App Store Connect steps: create new version, release notes, screenshots, select build, submit for review
Mentions Apple review timeline (24-48 hours typical)
Mentions the choice between manual and automatic release after approval
